target_fidelity.note: The target is an active, declarative past-simple negative sentence with no modal.

grammaticality.note: The target answer is grammatical English.

naturalness.note: The prompt context naturally supports the answer.

pedagogical_suitability.note: It gives focused practice with past-simple negation.

determinacy.note: The context permits other valid completions, such as “Omar decided not to open the door,” outside the accepted set.

non_target_language_simplicity.note: The vocabulary and situation are common and transparent.

no_answer_leakage.note: The completed target form is not displayed in the prompt.

no_extraneous_grammar.note: Producing the target requires only basic past-simple negation.

no_world_knowledge.note: No external or specialist knowledge is needed.
